guidelines.detail: same as LRN-006 (The description indicates that packaging can proceed while other work is underway, and the flow records show that the generated model instead sequences tasks and diverges from the reference branching and synchronization.)

same as LRN-003 (The label pairs show generated labels that change or omit the described action or decision, while the description gives the intended meanings. LRN-003 already expresses essentially the same guidance.)

documentation rule LANE-01 not applied (The description assigns work to the secretary, logistics department head, and warehousemen, while the records show that the corresponding reference lanes have no counterpart in the generated model. The generated external-company pool and message flow are not evidence that those internal lanes are unnecessary. LANE-01 already states the same lane-modeling principle.)

documentation rule GW-06 not applied (The description makes the package label activity required and insurance conditional, while the generated model lacks the reference inclusive split and join. Documented guideline GW-06 already covers inclusive branching and synchronization of activated branches.)

refines GW-06 (The description distinguishes an always-performed action from an action required only when a condition holds. The generated exclusive gateway cannot represent both branches being activated, while the reference uses inclusive split and join gateways. This specializes GW-06 for the case of a mandatory branch alongside a conditional branch.)

same as LRN-034 (The description states that packaging can happen while other work is underway, and the reference includes a packaging activity missing from the generated model. LRN-034 already covers modeling simultaneous or independent actions on separate parallel branches.)

same as LRN-005 (The missing gateway and flows indicate that the alternative handling paths were not merged before the later shared activity. This is supported by the description of special shipping for large amounts and normal post shipment for small amounts (S2–S4), and matches learned guideline LRN-005.)

same as LRN-016 (The label differences are supported by the description, which states the relevant shipping decisions, activities, and outcome. LRN-016 already advises preserving the stated details in BPMN labels, so this guideline expresses the same principle.)

new guideline (The generated external pool and its message flows have no reference counterparts, while the description assigns the stated work to an in-scope role and gives no further account of the providers’ work. The guideline avoids expanding that limited description into a separate collaboration.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that distinct activities happen independently during the same ongoing period: Model the activities as separate branches from a parallel gateway rather than sequencing them, and synchronize the branches only if all must finish before the process continues.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an activity can be performed before other ongoing work is complete

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names a distinct activity or outcome and states its action or completion condition: Label the corresponding BPMN element with the described action or outcome. Do not replace it with a broader or narrower action, or add detail the description does not support.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a distinct activity, decision, or outcome and identifies its action or condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns activities to distinct internal roles or departments

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use an inclusive split when one or more conditions can be true; use an inclusive join to synchronize only activated reachable branches.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description requires one activity while making a separate activity conditional on whether it is needed

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one action must occur while another action occurs only if a condition holds: Model the actions as branches from an inclusive gateway, with the mandatory branch always activated and the conditional branch activated when its condition holds; use an inclusive join to synchronize the activated branches before continuing.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one action must occur while another action occurs only if a condition holds

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more actions occur at the same time, or that one action is independent of another after a shared prerequisite: Model the actions on separate branches from a parallel gateway. Use a parallel join only before a continuation that requires all those branches to finish.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an activity can proceed independently while other work is underway

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives for where or how an item is handled: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway and separate alternative paths, then merge them before any shared next step.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive ways of handling an item and then describes a later activity shared by those alternatives

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies the action, decision, or outcome represented by a BPMN activity, gateway, or event

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description mentions an in-scope role contacting external providers and choosing among their responses, but does not describe the providers’ work beyond making those responses: Model the described contact and selection within the in-scope process; do not add an external pool or message flows solely to represent the implied request and responses.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description mentions an in-scope role contacting external providers and choosing among their responses, but does not describe the providers’ work beyond making those responses
